card.name: Digits inside citation and ISBN numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (usually 4, 5 or 7) in the middle of a journal volume number, ISBN or ISSN or DOI in a reference list or bibliography.

modes.label: ISBN digits
modes.description: A digit early in the number group of an ISBN after the 978-1- or 1- prefix.

modes.label: Journal volume numbers
modes.description: The last digit of a journal volume such as Nature 444 or Science 324, before the page range.

card.plain: It fires on a digit inside the numbers of a reference, such as a journal volume or ISBN.
